name: Islands Void
design_intent:
FLAGSHIP islands-over-a-void arena (owner directive 2026-07-04 arena_variety; v3 geometry pass per CD VERDICT #4, docs/briefs/cd_verdict4_2026-07-04_islands_audio.md). Kill identity = knock rivals OFF / BETWEEN separated islands into the bottom blast void -> off the screen (kill_shape class = void_is_floor; QA uses K1' per docs/specs/v2a_kill_shape_void_floor_addendum.md, NOT the central_pit K1 target).

V3 CHANGE (GEOMETRY ONLY — no Tuning constant touched; fence per v1_level_circuit.md §6): CD #4 found ~64-75% of deaths were UNCREDITED self-suicides into the void (killer=-1), not credited smash-offs, from two seams: (a) the play islands were only 520-640px wide over a full-width lethal floor, so every boosted traversal had a razor-thin landing margin and bots/humans whiffed INTO the void constantly; (b) the fixed super impulse (2800, tuned for the 2x-wide grassy arena) over-launched the ATTACKER clear across a narrow island + gap + next island and off the far bound (self-ringout, no credit) because a narrow island gives no RUNWAY to decelerate after the fly-into-hit. FIX: the four play-tier islands are WIDENED from ~520-640px to a uniform 960px (~1.7x). Wider islands give (1) a forgiving landing pad so a boosted crossing no longer whiffs into the void, and (2) real mid-island runway so a super smash-off's forward carry (attacker retains only smash_self_retain=0.1 of momentum on a landed hit) stays OVER the wider island while the victim is launched across the remaining island + into the gap/void. Gaps were tightened from 680 to 580px (still > the 527px max spring drift and >> 395px trampoline drift => still FLIGHT-REQUIRED per Rule A) so the extra island width does not blow the arena width up, and so a whiffed inner-island super now lands the attacker on the NEXT island rather than off the far bound. The recovery sky (island bottom -> bottom blast line) stays 672-868px (>= 650, Rule D preserved). The two elevated spring thrones (F over the A->B gap / E over the B->C gap, both 520px above the nearest island top) are unchanged in role.

Geometry: A trampoline x0..960 top1080 / B bubblegum x1540..2500 top940 / C trampoline x3080..4040 top1120 / D bubblegum x4620..5580 top980, over ONE full-width lethal void (rim y=1260, whole bottom band is a dark chasm). Two elevated spring thrones (F x1080..1420 top560 over the A->B gap / E x2620..3000 top420 over the B->C gap) sit ABOVE spring apex, boost-only. Bounds -560..6140 keep the side edges as blast lines too, but the DOMINANT kill shape is the bottom void.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px, bubblegum apex 180px, spring apex 480px, air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~395px off a trampoline / ~320px off bubblegum / ~527px off a spring; normal_boost_max 760px/s crosses a 580px gap in <0.9s @ ~24 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything):
- GAP A->B: island edges x960..x1540 = 580px horizontal over open void. > 527 (max spring drift, and no spring sits at gap height here) and >> 395 (trampoline drift). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B->C: x2500..x3080 = 580px over the void (spring throne E hangs over it). > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- GAP C->D: x4040..x4620 = 580px over the void. > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to spring throne F (top560): 520px above island A's top (1080) AND ~600px horizontally offset (F hangs over the A->B gap) => a diagonal boosted arc, not a bounce. Trampoline apex from A only reaches y=810 (270 rise) -> 250px short even before the horizontal offset. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to spring throne E (top420): 520px above island B's top (940) AND offset over the B->C gap. Bubblegum apex (180) reaches y=760 -> 340px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED, and an under-shot climb drops into the chasm. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER earns the throne fast).
- Every play-tier gap (580px) exceeds even a spring bounce's reach (527) and far exceeds a trampoline/bubblegum bounce (395/320), and every elevated pad sits >= 520px above the nearest surface, so NO route across or up the arena exists without the jetpack. The wider 960px islands give a forgiving LANDING for a boosted crossing (fewer whiff-falls) and RUNWAY for a super smash-off (attacker lands back on-island; victim rings out) WITHOUT making any gap bounce-hoppable. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.

RECOVERY GAMBLE: the fall from an island bottom (1052-1248) to the bottom blast line (1920) is 672-868px of open sky over the chasm -> a knocked-off player who still has fuel can boost back to an island (the recovery gamble), while a near-edge dead-on super spikes them straight past the rim. Side runways (560px outside the outer island edges) preserve the near-edge-out / mid-stage-arcs-back gradient on the left/right blast lines. VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark cool bottomless gradient + receding dirt canyon walls at the arena sides + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons along y=1260 + falling motes) so the whole bottom is unmistakably lethal, not safe green.
